description: This Java class 'HttpRequestSerializer' extends 'StdSerializer' to serialize 'HttpRequest' objects into JSON format using Jackson library. It defines how various fields of an HttpRequest are converted into JSON fields, including headers, cookies, body, and other request attributes.

classes.name: HttpRequestSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for HttpRequest objects, converting them into JSON format.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer for HttpRequest class.

methods.description: Method that serializes an HttpRequest object into JSON using JsonGenerator.
